closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin C, usually beats ultra-processed sweet snacks, and easy to use as a whole food, but the biggest weaknesses are low protein amount, low potassium, and low omega 3. It is good for immune support, low-calorie volume, and practical meals because vitamin C gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure, and the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around.
